description: This is a shell script (.sh) file containing test cases and setup code for testing the 'gitweb' CGI interface as a standalone script. It performs various tests such as snapshot creation, project forks, security checks, and HTML output validation, by sourcing external scripts and executing commands related to Git and web interface testing.

methods.name: check_snapshot
methods.description: Function to verify that the snapshot tarball and headers are correctly generated for given repository basename and prefix.
